scope.description: These are non-exclusive suggestions for useful mathematical translation work. Contributors may propose any other mathematical work whose source identity and permission for translation derivatives can be verified.
scope.coverage_rule: Language coverage is work-specific. Empty or unknown coverage never means that no translation exists.
scope.legacy_id_rule: legacy_id preserves a key from a non-public planning snapshot for backward compatibility only; it is not a public work identifier.

language_priority.priority_rule: Prefer languages for which communities document limited access to university-level mathematical material, and record the exact locale, script, orthographic standard, intended learners, and available reviewers.

unesco_source.title: New UNESCO report calls for multilingual education to unlock learning and inclusion
reported_facts: 40% of people globally lack access to education in a language they speak and understand fluently.
More than a quarter-billion learners are affected.
Only 351 of roughly 7,000 spoken or signed languages are used as a medium of instruction.

language_priority.note: No official UNESCO list of 96 underserved languages was identified. The Commons will not attribute a numbered priority list to UNESCO without an exact source.

evidence.note: This catalog preserves a bounded planning projection derived from two exact non-public coordination snapshots, plus one independently verified public upstream boundary for openlogic-core. evidence.consumer_rule: Use semantic id as the public key. Treat legacy_id and reported_status as historical planning provenance. Begin translation only after the selected work's source identity, derivative license, component boundary, editable source, and baseline build are independently frozen.
